qwen-3.8-max-ga-2026-08-03.name: Qwen3.8-Max general availability

A local Token Plan probe on 2026-08-03 confirmed GET /models returns both qwen3.8-max and qwen3.8-max-preview and that a chat completion pinned to qwen3.8-max returns .model == "qwen3.8-max" with reasoning_effort xhigh accepted.

Alibaba has published no benchmark table for Qwen3.8-Max, and no DeepSWE or Terminal-Bench v2 row exists for it on any harness, so this source cannot satisfy builder required metrics. The announcement post could not be read directly (x.com returned HTTP 402); its pricing figures reached this record through a search-engine summary and are unverified. Open weights had not shipped when observed. The alibabacloud.com international documentation mirror still listed no qwen3.8 model.

clerk.note: Repository comprehension is primary; cost and tool reliability break ties.

scout.note: Repository comprehension is primary; steerability and latency are supporting evidence.

builder.note: General implementation needs both repository changes and terminal execution evidence.

frontend-builder.note: WebDev preference is valid only for frontend/product implementation, not general builder work.

reviewer.note: Coding or WebDev scores never substitute for a review-specific benchmark.

senior.note: Real-world correction handling and user outcomes are primary; review and taste remain domain-specific.

judgement.note: No public coding leaderboard is sufficient to auto-qualify architecture or final-judgement work.

evidence.note: Signs read visually from the rendered board on 2026-08-05, which settles the earlier sign_inferred flag: every effect except tool hallucination is negative, so this model is measurably worse than the baseline agent in real sessions, and steerability at -6.70% is the scout lane's supporting metric. The first automated capture recorded five of these as positive because the board encodes direction as a coloured triangle rather than a character, and the text conversion dropped it.
